crops_opened_note: F7 (Scheme 1) and F10 (Scheme 2) are offered as 'crop (whole figure)' with no separate crop file, so the whole figure images were opened and their whole-figure panel ids cited. The other 17 crop files were opened individually, in addition to all 10 whole-figure images.
technique_cue_check_note: Eight cited panels carry a cue class, all 'electrochemistry': F1b, F2a, F2b, F3a, F3b, F5a, F9a and F9b, cited with technique ECHEM:GCD (family ECHEM is on the electrochemistry list). All other cited crops have cue classes [] and are not checked; the techniques used there are ECHEM:EIS (F1a, ionic conductivity vs temperature), SEM and SEM:EDS (F4a, F4b, F6a, F6b), ECHEM:GCD (F5b), XPS (F8a, F8b) and [OPTICAL:photograph, CHROM:IC] (F8c, a photograph carrying ion-chromatography values). No citation had to be moved or dropped.
merged_nodes: F1a: the conductivity-vs-temperature trend and the 4 mS/cm value at 20 C merged into one OBS o1 - one reading of one curve pair; the 20 C value sits in the label and image_note instead of a second characteristic_value node

F6a/F6b: the peak assignment (the labels Mn, Co, Ni written on both panels) and the intensity comparison merged into one OBS o12 (feature_quantification) - the assignment is not argued anywhere and only the amount enters n8

F8c: the colour loss of the Co2+/Ni2+ solutions and the annotated ion-chromatography values (761 -> 1 ppm, 730 -> 5 ppm) merged into one OBS o15 - both state the single scavenging result, and the panel is one photograph with the numbers written on it

n22 (initial performance is the same for both electrolytes) absorbs the first-cycle and fifth-cycle claims as one node, with F2a and F2b kept as two OBS because the two panels are read differently (a value difference vs a whole-curve coincidence)

NOT merged: n9 (negative crosstalk, Scheme 1) and n14 (positive crosstalk, Scheme 2) kept as two MEC/pathway nodes - they are the two opposite mechanisms the paper contrasts, and n14 explains n8 while n9 explains n6
NOT merged: n10 (micro short-circuits) and n11 (loss of active Li) kept apart, since they enter n6 as the two joint causes of the rollover (rule 7) and are read from different features of F5a
NOT merged: n12 (surface-layer composition, F8a) and n26 (chemical identity of the LixPOyFz from the P2p binding energy, F8b) - different panels and different claims; n26 stays off the spine
The two schemes are the authors' mechanism drawings, so they are attached as figs to the MEC nodes they draw (n9 -> F7, n14 -> F10) rather than turned into OBS readout nodes
packet_defects: Packet figure ids run one ahead of the paper's figure numbers after F6: packet F7 is Scheme 1, F8 is paper Figure 7, F9 is paper Figure 8 and F10 is Scheme 2.

The F4 image has lost its '(a) 1.0 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 by wt.)' header row: the string appears prepended to the F4 caption in the packet ('（a) 1.0 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 by wt.) Figure 4. SEM-EDX images ...') and panel F4b is annotated with its own '(b)' header while F4a is not. Assigning the top row to the EC-based electrolyte therefore needs the caption, and o7, o8 and n7 carry that in requires_unseen.
F2a caption says 0.1C = 79 mA g-1 while the panel is annotated 'Cycle 1 (19 mA g-1)'; the F2b caption's 1C = 190 mA g-1 does match its panel.

The F2 linked text says 'The voltage profiles ... are depicted in Figure 2b for a charge cut-off voltage of 4.5 V' and then describes the initial charge, which is panel 2a; the paragraph names Figure 2b twice for two different panels.
The F7 (Scheme 1) linked text is the Figure 3 paragraph with fragments of the Figure 4 and Figure 8 paragraphs appended; the parser linked several figures' text to the scheme.

F6a and F6b carry no intensity axis and cover different energy ranges (5.75-7.6 vs 5.5-7.7 keV), so 'significantly more TMs' (caption) can only be read qualitatively; o12 is image_support partial for that reason.
In F2b the EC-based (grey) trace is completely hidden under the EC-free (blue) one, so the coincidence is shown but the EC-based curve cannot be inspected on its own.
audit_notes: a1 qualifies n7: at the 100 um field of F4 the SEM frames resolve only diffuse bright patches, not dendrite morphology, although the caption says 'Li dendrites can be already seen with SEM'; the dendrite identity rests on the F map and ref. 20.
a2 qualifies n6: F3a shows the EC-based capacity partly recovering after cycle ~85 (60 -> 82 mAh/g) with error bars of about +/-40 mAh/g, neither of which the text mentions.

a3 qualifies n12: on the F8a anode bars the total degraded-LiPF6 fraction is nearly the same for the two electrolytes (~10 vs ~11.5 at%); what changes is the redistribution from low-F to high-F LixPOyFz (0.5 -> 8.5 at%), which is weaker than the text's 'significantly higher portion of degraded LiPF6 products'.
